name: Chocolate & Raspberry Protein Overnight Oats
steps: Combine the oats, protein powder, cocoa powder and chia seeds in a dish, pot, tub or jar with a lid.
Pour in the milk, yoghurt and honey and mix until combined.
Put the lid on and store in the fridge overnight (or for at least 3 hours).
When ready to eat, remove from the fridge and top with an extra layer of yoghurt, some raspberries, a drizzle of honey and some shaved or broken-up dark chocolate.
